question: How much is the first pistol round worth, and does the side matter?
answer: First pistol winner takes the map 59.5%: 57.1% on CT, 61.9% on T.
findings: Pistol 1 won on CT: map win 57.1% (56.1%-58.2%, n=8,809).
Pistol 1 won on T: map win 61.9% (60.9%-63.0%, n=8,716).
Both pistols: 69.3% map win (n=8,912). Split pistols, P1 winner: 49.4%.
Above Elo expectation: P1 on T +11.3 pp, on CT +6.0 pp. Win vs lose P1, Elo-adjusted: +17.2 pp (+16.0 to +18.6 pp).
method: Map win % for pistol round winners (rounds 1 and 13), Wilson CIs. Team strength: logistic model with pre-map Elo; pistol effects as average marginal change, map-clustered CIs.
data: bo3.gg round data, S/A/B-tier pro maps, 2023-10-16 to 2026-11-02, 17,525 maps
split_check: P1 winner map win: early 59.3% (n=8,762), late 59.7% (n=8,763).

chart.title: Map win % after winning a pistol round
